QuestInfo.name: [Valentine's Day] Sweet in the Center
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra is thinking about sharing her Valentine's spirit with chocolates this year.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra's Valentine's Day Chocolate will turn into Sugarheart Chocolate if you hold onto it for 30 minutes. It's like magic!
QuestInfo.2: Who's going to get these Sugarheart Chocolates?

0.0: I feel like it's my calling to be the herald of love this year. I wish I could do it right now. Like an instant messenger of love! What should I call myself? The Maple Sweetheart Network... MSN? Yeah, that's catchy. You wanna help?

yes.0: I'll transmit your feelings to your beloved faster than you can type up a litigious email! Just hold on to this #r#i3994501##t3994501##k for #b30 minutes#k first.
yes.1: It gets way better with age. #bWhatever you do, don't log out! That chocolate is rigged to explode#k. Sorry, it was all I could find on short notice.

no.0: Well, let me know when you need a messenger of love. It's an important job.

item.0: I don't think the chocolate's filled with love yet. Hold on a little longer! And not too tight, or it'll melt.
